lane_title: Andersonian Tilt-Variational & Deconfounded Geothermal-Piedmont Submodular Fault Discovery

protocol_rules.holdout_scheme: 4-quadrant whole-8-connected-segment withholding with 30 px (3.0 km) training exclusion collar; visible-only catalogue features; pixel-exact visible-fault masking; 16-spatial-block bootstrap (2000 draws, seed=36)
banned_inputs: sample_submission.tif pixel values (footprint finite mask only)

ranked_hypotheses.title: Phase-Equalized Verduzco Tilt & Piedmont-Deconfounded Multi-Physics with Variational Anderson-Raissi Structure-Tensor Diffusion + 300 m Submodular Cover
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Verduzco tilt angle arctan(VG/HGM) + THDR |grad(tilt)| + multi-scale Hessian ridge/scarp-toe eigenvalues + relief-deconfounded piedmont scarp contrast + Raissi-Anderson structure-tensor diffusion + 300m CELF submodular cover
ranked_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Equalizes 1/z^2 burial decay beneath alluvial aprons, resolves the 24.63% 3DEP LiDAR coverage gap via missingness-aware potential-field splits, suppresses steep mountain-wall false positives, and damps E-W sigma_3-parallel acquisition striping
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Pluvial Lake Lahontan paleo-shoreline benches and NNE-striking basaltic feeder dikes

ranked_hypotheses.title: Hydrothermal Demagnetization Trough & Depth-Conditioned Clay-Cap Upflow Discordance
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Magnetite-destruction local RTP trough flanked by steep tilt walls + fold-regressed log(1+cond_surf) residual given basement depth + K/Th potassic metasomatic gradient + GDR geothermometer reservoir plume
ranked_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Blind geothermal faults (~39-50% of Great Basin systems) lack surface scarps yet host ascending hydrothermal brines that oxidize magnetite, form smectite clay caps, and enrich K/Th
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Saline evaporite playa brines adjacent to felsic ash-flow tuff margins

ranked_hypotheses.title: Basin-Floor Basement Flexural Hinge & 3-Regime Geomorphic Prevalence Calibration
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Signed second-derivative hinge of basement depth concordant with gravity vertical-gradient zero-crossing + fold-learned 3-regime (Mountain Block / Piedmont Apron / Basin Floor) prevalence calibration
ranked_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Recovers concealed intra-basin horst/graben growth faults beneath >250 m alluvium while preventing steep erosional mountain blocks from monopolizing probability ranks
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Differential sedimentary compaction hinge over buried pre-Tertiary paleo-topography

ranked_hypotheses.title: Raw GeoDAWN Tie-Line Crossover Micro-Levelling Residual
layers: USGS GeoDAWN raw line-located magnetic/radiometric flight profiles (DOI: 10.5066/P93LGLVQ)
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Along-track 10-50 m dipole edge steps surviving tie-line crossover levelling residualization
ranked_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Captures narrow (<100 m) intra-basin fault offsets attenuated by 100 m minimum-curvature gridding
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Linear cultural ferromagnetics (pipelines, powerlines, highway guardrails)
ranked_hypotheses.external_source_status: Official public-domain USGS ScienceBase release doi:10.5066/P93LGLVQ; not obtainable inside sandbox due to outbound host allowlist

ranked_hypotheses.title: Sentinel-1 OPERA InSAR Aquifer-Baffle Phase-Gradient & Coherence Step
layers: NASA/ASF OPERA_L3_DISP-S1_V1 North America Surface Displacement 30 m time series
ranked_hypotheses.physical_signature: Persistent horizontal LOS velocity step and seasonal poroelastic phase-gradient discontinuity across fault clay-core hydraulic barriers
ranked_hypotheses.off_catalogue_rationale: Concealed clay-rich fault cores compartmentalize alluvial aquifers even with zero surface scarp and weak magnetic contrast
ranked_hypotheses.non_fault_mimic: Agricultural pumping drawdown boundaries and stratigraphic clay-gravel pinchouts
ranked_hypotheses.external_source_status: Official NASA/ASF DAAC open product; requires Earthdata login and asf.alaska.edu outbound access unavailable in sandbox

experiments.name: ATVR36-Core

experiments.name: ATVR36-RegimeCal
experiments.description: Adds H36-C basement flexural hinge concordance + fold-learned 3-regime (Mountain/Piedmont/Basin) prevalence calibration before Raissi-Anderson diffusion and 300m CELF submodular cover
